subject: Endgame approvals, signature windows, and start-date gating
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Willis <jordan@stellarretail.com>; ProcureOps <procure@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Endgame: approvals, signature windows, start-date gating

Hi Jordan / ProcureOps team,

Thanks for the productive evaluation last week. We're aligned on the technical fit and the MAP you shared — to close cleanly I want to confirm the final gating and sign windows so Procurement and Legal can coordinate the PO/SOW signatures and we can lock a start date. Attached: SOW_v3_Redwood_Stellar.pdf and a draft MAP_timeline.xlsx with proposed sign windows.

High-level asks (please confirm owners + deadlines):
- Legal redlines: do you expect any additional SOW edits? (owner: Stellar Legal)
- PO issuance vs DocuSign: will you issue a PO first or sign the SOW via DocuSign? (ProcureOps)
- Final signer list and routing order: we need explicit signer names and email addresses by 2026-11-02 to lock DocuSign routing.
- Start date target: we proposed 2026-11-29 but will shift if signature routing creates delay.

We've highlighted three distinct approval gates in the MAP:
1) Commercial signoff (Procure/Finance) — required to generate the PO
2) Legal signoff (internal counsel/CS) — final SOW acceptance
3) Security/compliance acceptance (minor evidence exchange only) — CISO confirmation for production access

If you can confirm the routing approach (PO-first vs SOW-signature) and the primary signer for each gate by EOD 2026-11-02, my team will prepare the DocuSign envelope and coordinate start-date contingencies.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOW_v3_Redwood_Stellar.pdf (pdf, 298KB), MAP_timeline.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

From: Jordan Willis <jordan@stellarretail.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@stellarretail.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Endgame: approvals, signature windows, start-date gating

Mina — thanks, this helps. Quick answers:
- Stellar Legal: they have one small redline on data retention language; I can surface that by EOD Tuesday 2026-11-03.
- Procurement intent: we'll issue a PO; prefer that before electronic signature on SOW so internal finance can match the PO to the contract.
- Primary signers: CFO (k.ellis@stellarretail.com) for commercial, General Counsel (g.carter@stellarretail.com) for legal. I will confirm exact routing order tomorrow.
- Security: our security team (security@stellarretail.com) only needs the SOC2 summary and confirmation of log retention for 90 days; they'll thumbs-up quickly.

If PO-first is required, what is the minimum gap you need between PO issuance and SOW signature to avoid blocking the start date? Can Redwood accept a signed SOW + PO delivered within 3 business days?

— Jordan
VP Product, Stellar Retail
jordan@stellarretail.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Willis <jordan@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Endgame: approvals, signature windows, start-date gating

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Jordan's answers. Key items we need to finalize on our side:

- PO-first workflow: Jordan prefers PO before SOW signature. Legal: can we accept a PO + countersigned SOW where countersign occurs within 3 business days after PO receipt? If yes, we can set start date 2026-11-29 as planned; if not, we'll push to 2026-12-06.
- DocuSign routing: Ben, please draft a signer routing diagram (see attached Signature_Routing.png) that supports a PO-first acceptance path (i.e., Redwood countersigns once PO arrives).
- Evidence for security: Marissa, please add SOC2 summary and map our 90-day log retention note into the SOW Appendix. Jordan said security team will be quick.

Proposed immediate deadlines to keep the MAP tight:
- 2026-11-03: Stellar Legal redline passthrough (Jordan)
- 2026-11-04: Redwood legal updates SOW appendix (Marissa)
- 2026-11-05: ProcureOps issues PO (Jordan / ProcureOps)
- 2026-11-08: Redwood countersigns SOW and returns signed SOW to Stellar
- 2026-11-29: Target production start / onboarding kickoff (contingent on signed SOW + PO)

If any of you foresee blockers on Redwood's side (legal or ops), call them out now so I can coordinate an exception if needed.

Thanks,
Mina

> On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Willis <jordan@stellarretail.com> wrote:
> Mina — thanks, this helps. Quick answers:
> - Stellar Legal: they have one small redline on data retention language; I can surface that by EOD Tuesday 2026-11-03.
> - Procurement intent: we'll issue a PO; prefer that before electronic signature on SOW so internal finance can match the PO to the contract.
> - Primary signers: CFO (k.ellis@stellarretail.com) for commercial, General Counsel (g.carter@stellarretail.com) for legal. I will confirm exact routing order tomorrow.
> - Security: our security team (security@stellarretail.com) only needs the SOC2 summary and confirmation of log retention for 90 days; they'll thumbs-up quickly.

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Willis <jordan@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, ProcureOps <procure@stellarretail.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final go/no-go: sign windows confirmed and start-date contingency

Jordan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final confirmations below and explicit asks so we can close this week: 

Summary (final):
- Legal redline: Jordan confirmed one data-retention edit; Redwood legal (Marissa) incorporated the SOW Appendix edit on 2026-11-04.
- Procurement flow: Stellar will issue a PO on 2026-11-05. Redwood to countersign via DocuSign within 3 business days of PO receipt (target countersign 2026-11-08).
- Security: SOC2 summary attached and 90-day log retention language added to Appendix B. security@stellarretail.com OK to proceed.

Decision table (who signs what & deadline):
- CFO (Stellar) — commercial approval / issues PO — due 2026-11-05
- GC (Stellar) — legal acceptance / sign order — confirm routing by 2026-11-03
- Redwood Authorized Signer (Ben Carter) — countersign within 3 business days of PO

Start-date gating:
- If PO + countersigned SOW arrive by 2026-11-08, we keep 2026-11-29 start date.
- If countersign slips beyond 2026-11-08, we automatically move onboarding kickoff to 2026-12-06 to allow ops prep.

Next steps I will take today:
- Ben: I need a final Signature_Routing.png with DocuSign envelope steps and Ben's sign authority confirmed.
- Marissa: please attach the updated SOW_v3_Redwood_Stellar.pdf (final) to the DocuSign envelope and confirm Appendix B language.
- Jordan / ProcureOps: please confirm PO issuance time and send PO PDF to contracts@redwood.com as soon as it's issued.

If you confirm "PO will be sent on 2026-11-05" and Redwood countersigns within the 3-business-day window, this thread is our final go for the current MAP and we will proceed with activation for 2026-11-29. If Procurement needs a longer window, call it out now and we'll trigger the contingency.

Thanks — looking forward to the green light.

Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
Attachments: SOW_v3_Redwood_Stellar_final.pdf (pdf, 312KB), Signature_Routing.png (png, 85KB)
_thread_metadata_note: Messages are in chronological order (oldest first). Replies preserve realistic quoting and forwarded headers.
